scope: Three complete local static contracts; no runtime oracle, complete transitive effects or disk compatibility claim

abi.convention: cdecl supported by plain RET and observed caller cleanup
abi.argument_width: DWORD stack slots at entry ESP+4, +8, +c as applicable
abi.assumptions: Valid sufficiently sized memory, normal flat DS/ES, DF clear for copy; no pointer/count overflow for ordinary-range descriptions

functions.direction: Backward iff D>unsigned S and D<unsigned low32(S+N); forward otherwise
functions.body: Destination alignment by 1..3 bytes; REP MOVSD for >=8 DWORDs; unrolled 0..7 DWORD table and 0..3 byte tail; backward REP guarded by STD then CLD
functions.return: Original destination; zero count avoids source/destination memory access
functions.effects: Exactly N destination bytes for valid nonwrapping ranges with DF clear; source/destination may overlap; no calls/global writes/error return
functions.dispatch: 16 indirect jump sites; seven table-base/index-domain combinations, including negative indices and aliasing cells
functions.limits: Not a safety guarantee for wrapped addresses, invalid capacity/pointers, DF set or interrupted/faulting copies

functions.descriptor: F<unsigned DWORD[de43e0], entry=DWORD[de42e0+4*(signed(F)>>5)]+8*(F&31); BYTE entry+4 flag 0x01 required
functions.early_zero: After descriptor validation: count zero or descriptor flag 0x02
functions.prefix: When flags intersect 0x48 and cache!=LF, emit cached byte, decrement request, advance OS destination, set prefix_count=1, cache=LF; still issue main call for remaining zero
functions.text_flag4: Set BYTE descriptor flag 0x04 iff main_OS_count!=0 and original_destination[0]==LF; clear otherwise
functions.text_translation: In-place CRLF=>LF, standalone CR retained, 0x1a terminates output and sets flag 0x02 unless flag 0x40; bytes after0x1a can already be physically consumed
functions.trailing_CR: One-byte ReadFile lookahead: failure with nonzero last-error or count 0 emits CR; failure with last-error0 still consults count/byte outputs, not preinitialized here
functions.lookahead_flag48: With flags 0x48: LF emits LF; non-LF emits CR and caches lookahead
functions.lookahead_other: If output empty and lookaheadLF emitLF; otherwise call 0094c552(F,-1,1), ignore result, emitCR only for non-LF
functions.text_return: Compacted output byte count, unsigned pointer-end scan; no output terminator
functions.mutation_failure_limit: Destination/cache may already change before main failure returns0/-1; no rollback. Lookahead failure can return prior output rather than-1. Short successful reads are not filled locally

functions.gates: LowBYTE flags missing all0x83 or containing0x40 =>-1 unchanged locally; else bit0x02 =>OR DWORD flags 0x20 and-1
functions.prepare: OR flags 0x01; if WORD flags intersects 0x10c reset cursor=buffer base, otherwise 0094ec37(stream), ignoring return
functions.failure: 0 =>OR flags 0x10; -1=>OR flags 0x20; both set count 0 and return -1
functions.successful_flag: If stream flags lack0x82, read descriptor flags through table or fallback ad91f0 for F=-1; descriptor(flags&0x82)==0x82 =>OR stream flags 0x2000
functions.size_change: After read, refill_size==0x200 and stream flag 0x08 set and0x400 clear =>refill_size=0x1000
functions.consume: Every result except0/-1: count=low32(result-1); return MOVZX BYTE[*cursor], cursor++; no positive-result/capacity check
functions.limits: Does not first consume existing count. No independent descriptor bounds check after successful read; buffer preparation/capacity/failure remains transitive

unresolved_dependencies.boundary: OS error argument; global/thread error mapping unresolved
(descriptor,-1,1); seek-shaped arguments, actual position/failure effects unresolved; return ignored

remaining_limits: No stream/descriptor initialization or lifetime/concurrency proof
No valid file corpus or runtime host API trace
No equivalence of output, cached cursor, logical position and physical handle advancement
No connected game/subsystem or complete database/save compatibility
